description: Two knobs, each holding a steady voltage at its own jack, for offsets and for setting another module's CV input by hand

params.text: Sets the voltage carried by OUT 1, -10V to +10V
Sets the voltage carried by OUT 2, -10V to +10V

outputs.text: Carries the voltage set by the CONST 1 knob, -10V to +10V, with no smoothing or slew
Carries the voltage set by the CONST 2 knob, -10V to +10V, with no smoothing or slew

notes: the two halves are wholly separate: neither knob or jack has any effect on the other.
